_doc: ubc.py rebuilds of heroes whose approved look predates a later global builder change (ubc_parts.LEGACY): 'tint' = no light-plate boost (172c5c7), 'gown' = no cloth coat/gown skirt from the later 'greatcoat'/'long coat' triggers (172c5c7), 'parts' = Pack/Part names unnormalised (411b530). Found by rebuilding for the headgear pass (2026-11-28) and diffing the body below the neck against the shipped model; each entry reproduces the shipped body (mean colour difference < 1/255).
